name: Maela Rusk
source_profile:
Hearthmother Maela Rusk (NG)

Maela is a respected leader chosen by the principal Rathen clans to mediate disputes and represent their interests. She is cautious toward Cadorian settlement but believes the Rathen can coexist with their new neighbors if their traditional migration routes and grazing lands are respected. Maela has sought discussions with representatives of Marquis Garrus Ashford, although she remains skeptical of promises made on behalf of distant authorities.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 56 (source excerpt; may be partial)
